## About
Ace Auto Smog is a smog shop on Pacheco Blvd in Martinez. We're part of a family-owned automotive group, so if your car needs work beyond the smog check, our repair facility, Ace Auto Care, is there to help.
Customers tell us they like how quickly they get in and out, and that we're upfront about how long the wait will be. Randy gets a mention in our reviews, and a reviewer says they've been coming back for years.
If your car doesn't pass, we'll walk you through what's wrong and what your options are. Our goal is to make the whole thing as easy as it can be.

## Services
- Smog check: Our team runs a full smog check on your car. If it passes, we send the success report to the authorities.
- Smog test again for free: If your car fails and you get it fixed at another repair shop, we'll be happy to run the smog test again for free.

## FAQ
Q: What should I bring?
A: One reviewer suggests bringing your driver's license, your DMV paperwork, and your car's mileage.

Q: What happens if my car fails?
A: We'll print out a full report of the problems. You can get them fixed at our repair facility, Ace Auto Care, or another shop, and then come back for another smog test.

Q: How long does a smog check take?
A: One reviewer says they were told it usually takes about 15 minutes, and that they really were in and out that fast.
